_readme: Config for statusline.js / statusline-refresh.js (footer under the input box).
_segments: Footer line, pieces joined by '  ·  '. Any of: model, mode, cwd, git, cost, balance. Reorder or remove freely.
_prices: Prices in USD per 1M tokens, split into the provider's peak and off_peak windows. Each usage record is priced with the window in force at its own timestamp, then converted with usd_to_cny. cache_hit = prompt cache read, cache_miss = uncached input, output = completion tokens. Editing this table invalidates the incremental cost cache, so totals are recomputed instead of mixed.
_prices_source: https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing - deepseek-flash & deepseek-v4-pro, peak = 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri (off-peak is half of peak), checked 2026-09-21. Legacy names deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp are still billed at the Flash price.
